notes.title: Update 1.03! Rebalancing!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, adventurers of Elonia![/p][p]A small rebalancing update. ^^[/p][p]What’s new:[/p][list][*][p]\[General] Increased gold and influence gains at the end of each chapter,[/p][/*][*][p]\[Necromancer Faction] Increased healing gain (from +2 to +3) and defense (from +2 to +3) for the ,[/p][/*][*][p]\[Necromancer Faction] Undead now have a "lifespan." After 3 game turns, a summoned undead is automatically recalled.[/p][/*][/list][p]Enjoy! ^^[/p]

notes.title: Update v1.02! New language added!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, adventurers of Elonia![/p][p][/p][p]Great news, the game is now available in German![/p][p]Note: please start a campaign from the beginning to fully apply the language change.[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy! ^^[/p]

notes.title: The wait is over, Kingdoms of Dice is available!
notes.content: [p][i]Kingdoms of Dice[/i] is finally available! ^^[/p][p]Discover the sequel to [i]Fate and Destiny[/i], immersing you in a heroic fantasy universe inspired by dice-based board games.[/p][p]Continue to uncover the chronicles of Elonia through four iconic factions, across four scripted campaigns.[/p][p]To succeed in your adventure, upgrade your band of fighters, purchase bonus cards, and roll your resource dice to activate each warrior’s abilities.[/p][p]Test your leadership skills in multiple game modes: standard campaigns, advanced campaigns, and skirmishes.[/p][p]The dice of destiny await, so don’t hesitate—dive into [i]Kingdoms of Dice[/i]![/p][p]Enjoy! ^^[/p]
